map.输入活动URL与渠道参数，生成带UTM追踪参数的二维码活动链接，用于统计线下海报: Enter a campaign URL and channel parameters to generate a QR campaign link with UTM tracking parameters, used to count scans and sources from offline posters and materials.
map.不同渠道（朋友圈/公众号/线下）各放一个码追踪扫码量。: Place a separate code per channel (moments/official account/offline) to track scans.
map.对比各码扫码与后续转化看渠道效果。: Compare scans and downstream conversions per code to see channel performance.
map.活动结束汇总各码数据做复盘。: After the campaign, aggregate the data per code for a review.
map.：3 个码分别投朋友圈/公众号/线下海报，活动期扫码 1200/800/300，: : 3 codes placed in moments/official account/offline poster; during the campaign scans were 1200/800/300, with moments contributing the most; if the official account converts better, shift budget next time.
map.：线下码扫码 300 但到店转化 60（20%），朋友圈 1200 扫码仅转化: : the offline code got 300 scans but 60 store conversions (20%), while moments got 1,200 scans and only 120 conversions (10%); offline is smaller in volume but higher in quality.
map.一个活动为什么用多个码？: Why use multiple codes for one campaign?
map.同活动多码可归因各渠道独立表现，避免把所有流量混在一起无法优化。: Multiple codes for the same campaign let you attribute each channel's performance independently, avoiding lumping all traffic together so it cannot be optimized.
map.扫码量低就是码不行？: Do low scans mean the code is bad?
map.不一定，受曝光位置与激励影响，应结合「曝光×扫码率」看，而非只看绝对数。: Not necessarily; it depends on placement and incentives, so read it together with "impressions x scan rate" rather than the absolute number alone.
